description:
Ben jij de engineer die organisaties naar het volgende niveau tilt met de kracht van Microsoft Power Platform én AI? 

Join the journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Platform Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het Microsoft Power Platform team van HSO: een snelgroeiende afdeling met een ondernemende mindset waarin jouw expertise noodzakelijk is om verder te kunnen groeien. Jij ontwerpt de fundamenten waarop klanten hun digitale transformatie bouwen — van datamodel tot beveiliging tot ALM — en zorgt dat AI-gedreven oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn. 

Jij bent vanaf de salesfase betrokken om samen met het beoogde klantteam de klant op weg te helpen met onze aanpak en propositie. Jij kunt in alle vrijheid platform- en AI-implementatietrajecten uitdenken en begeleiden. In sommige gevallen opereer je alleen, in andere gevallen gesteund door een ervaren en gemotiveerd team — waaronder de AI Platform Consultant, die het business probleem, het functional design en de user journeys aanlevert als basis voor jouw technisch ontwerp. 

Kerntaken: 

  • Je ontwerpt Dataverse-modellen en de bijbehorende security-architectuur (tabellen, relaties, business rules, rollen en rechten), inclusief de datagrondslag (grounding) waarop AI-agents veilig kunnen redeneren. 
  • Je kiest en onderbouwt het juiste patroon per vraagstuk: app, portal, workflow of AI-agent, en ontwerpt de technische architectuur van Copilot Studio-agents (topics, plugins, connectoren, Azure OpenAI-integratie). 
  • Je bepaalt de ALM- en omgevingsstrategie (dev/test/acceptatie/productie, pipelines, release management), inclusief versiebeheer en promotie van AI-agents en hun kennisbronnen. 
  • Je richt governance en beveiliging voor AI in: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant- en environment-instellingen voor Copilot Studio, en monitoring/observability van agentgedrag. 
  • Je beoordeelt en valideert AI-gegenereerde oplossingsontwerpen en -code op kwaliteit, security, kosten en schaalbaarheid, en stuurt bij waar nodig. 

 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau. 
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie bij een IT-dienstverlener, consultancy of aan klantzijde. 
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen van Dataverse-datamodellen en security-architectuur (rollen, teams, business units, field-level security). 
  • Ervaring met het afwegen en kiezen tussen app-, portal-, workflow- en agent-patronen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van en ervaring met het definiëren van ALM- en omgevingsstrategieën (pipelines, solution management, environment strategy). 
  • Ervaring met het reviewen en valideren van (AI-gegenereerde) solution designs en code. 
  • Kennis van het technisch ontwerpen van AI-agents in Copilot Studio: topics, plugins, connectoren, grounding op Dataverse en integratie met Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry. 
  • Kennis van AI-governance en beveiliging: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant-instellingen, monitoring en responsible AI-principes. 
  • Goede kennis van Power Platform-onderdelen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van of ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM) en Azure is een pre. 
  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams (Solution Architecten, Project Managers). 
  • Ervaring als Lead Architect of Solution Architect met grote, complexe systemen, bij voorkeur met meerdere (Microsoft) platforms. 
  • Ervaring met Prince II & Agile/Scrum projectmethodieken 

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris en jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt  
    voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens  
    je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 23 cent per kilometer; 
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • Telefoonabonnement & standaard telefoon of CYOD met bijbetaling of EUR 10,- netto per maand voor eigen telefoon;  
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Pensioen van BeFrank;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma en daarna heeft onze HSO-Academy een leerreis voor je gedefinieerd;  
  • Je ontvangt ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  


Over HSO    

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
 

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  
 

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

Ben je klaar voor de stap naar Enterprise Level Solution Architectuur? Kom dan kennismaken bij HSO! Join the Journey!

Als Azure Integration Architect begeleid jij klanten inhoudelijk in hun reis naar de Microsoft Cloud of bij het professionaliseren van de Cloud Competence. Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Job responsibilities: Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships. Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric. Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark. Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring. About you You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you. You have: Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java) A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production Bonus points: Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1) CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products Python or Rust alongside Go Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media What makes this role exciting Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships. Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company. Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use. Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached. Why join Stream? We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

What You'll Do

Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.
  • Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
  • Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.
  • Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
  • Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
  • Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
  • Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
  • Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
  • Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
  • Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
  • Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.

Local Day Two Operations Readiness

  • Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
  • Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post-handover.
  • Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post-handover.
  • Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
  • Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
  • Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
  • Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post-handover period to smooth the transition.

Reliability, Safety & Compliance

  • Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
  • Facilitate root-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
  • Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign-off.
  • Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301) ahead of go-live.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
  • Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go-live at risk.
  • Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.

Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics

  • Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post-handover incident rate, etc.).
  • Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
  • Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

About You

Experience & Background

  • 3-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
  • Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).

Technical Knowledge & Expertise

  • Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.
  • Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.
  • Knowledge of Layer 1 network infrastructure, including fiber, copper, optics, and transceivers.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms used by local Operations teams.

Influence & Communication

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align Construction, Network, Compute, and Operations teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to translate technical detail between teams with different priorities and vocabularies.
  • Program management discipline, with the ability to track and drive multiple concurrent workstreams to closure.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, matrixed, fast-moving environments.
  • Bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and delivering results with urgency.

Operational Excellence

  • Rigorous tracking of readiness checklists, risk logs, and action items across many concurrent site transitions within your assigned region.
  • Proven ability to build and refine standardized transition frameworks that scale with business growth.
  • Strong attention to detail in transition documentation and handover packages.
  • Willingness to travel to sites during critical transition windows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with program management tooling (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Jira, monday.com) for tracking multi-workstream transitions.
  • Familiarity with network cutover or compute/hardware deployment processes specifically.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms and ticketing workflows.
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar data platforms for operational analytics.

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping.   • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences

  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team

Description 

En tant qu’Enterprise Account Executive (F/H/X) pour la France, vous contribuerez directement à la croissance de Contentful en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu’à la signature. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la génération de nouveaux revenus et l’identification d’opportunités d’upsell auprès de nos clients actuels et de nouveaux clients.

Vous contribuerez également aux initiatives d’accompagnement et d’adoption de nos solutions par les clients, tout en adoptant une approche commerciale consultative. Vous serez capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec des experts techniques qu’avec des décideurs et dirigeants métier.

En collaboration étroite avec nos équipes Customer Experience, BDR, Partenariats et Marketing, vous développerez et fidéliserez notre portefeuille de clients sur le marché français.

Ce que vous ferez concrètement 

  • Collaborer avec notre équipe commerciale transverse afin d’accompagner les clients actuels et potentiels dans l’adoption des différentes fonctionnalités et solutions de Contentful.
  • Identifier, positionner, négocier et conclure des opportunités d’expansion auprès de nos clients existants.
  • Atteindre les objectifs commerciaux trimestriels et annuels en élaborant une stratégie de compte et un pipeline commercial, en pilotant les processus internes et clients, en assurant le suivi des activités commerciales, en développant votre connaissance du marché et de la concurrence, en présentant nos solutions aux clients et en élaborant des propositions commerciales.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes BDR afin d’identifier les clients potentiels et de qualifier les leads.
  • Prospecter et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales sur un territoire défini. Effectuer des recherches, identifier les interlocuteurs clés et qualifier les leads entrants afin de développer de nouvelles relations commerciales. Entretenir ensuite des relations à forte valeur ajoutée avec les principaux décideurs en devenant un véritable partenaire de confiance.
  • Piloter les demandes de RFI/RFQ en collaboration avec les équipes internes de Contentful et les équipes clientes.
  • Faire évoluer et optimiser notre modèle « land-and-expand » en collaboration avec les équipes Sales, Partenariats, Marketing et Customer Experience.
  • Identifier les enjeux liés aux expériences digitales de nos prospects et clients, et mettre en évidence le ROI de Contentful pour y répondre, afin de privilégier une approche commerciale fondée sur la valeur.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Solution Engineers afin d’identifier les problématiques techniques et les opportunités associées.
  • Élaborer des propositions commerciales, positionner des structures tarifaires complexes et négocier efficacement les contrats ainsi que les conditions nécessaires à la conclusion des affaires.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Customer Experience et Marketing afin de garantir que les bonnes pratiques Contentful soient partagées et mises en œuvre auprès des clients concernés.

Description

Qualified est la plateforme de marketing agentique propulsée par l'IA de Salesforce, hébergeant Piper — l'agent SDR IA n°1 — qui engage, qualifie et convertit de manière autonome les leads B2B entrants en pipeline à grande échelle, 24h/24 et 7j/7. Salesforce a récemment fait l'acquisition de Qualified, et nous développons actuellement sa fonction go-to-market pour la région EMEA en partant de zéro. Il s'agit d'une opportunité rare de rejoindre une région pour une entreprise en forte croissance et récemment acquise, alors qu'elle s'intègre au sein de l'un des plus grands éditeurs de logiciels d'entreprise au monde — combinant l'agilité et le rythme d'une start-up avec l'échelle et les ressources de Salesforce.

Nous recherchons un Enterprise Account Executive pour stimuler les revenus issus de nouveaux clients à travers la France, en pilotant l'ensemble du cycle de vente sur un territoire défini. Vous serez l'un des premiers Enterprise AEs sur le terrain pour Qualified, ce qui signifie que vous aurez une influence directe sur la façon dont la stratégie territoriale et les playbooks de vente prennent forme, au moment où cette activité s'établit au sein de l'écosystème plus large Agentforce/Data360 de Salesforce.

Ce rôle convient à une personne qui s'épanouit dans l'ambiguïté et apprécie le défi de construire quelque chose de nouveau — quelqu'un qui voit une opportunité là où d'autres pourraient voir de l'incertitude. Faire partie d'une toute nouvelle équipe apporte son propre mélange stimulant de liberté et de défis.

Ainsi, parallèlement à la croissance des revenus, vous apporterez curiosité, débrouillardise et un esprit collaboratif — en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec la direction d'Agentforce, les AEs Data Cloud et des équipes transversales plus larges pour aider à établir la place de Qualified au cœur de la stratégie go-to-market de Salesforce.

L'expérience En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution d'un plan stratégique de compte/territoire complet, ainsi que du pilotage des ventes sur un territoire et/ou une liste de comptes définis afin d'atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Vous apporterez une approche axée sur les solutions pour vendre, en aidant les prospects à comprendre comment nos produits dans le secteur du marketing conversationnel et de la génération de pipeline répondent à leurs besoins professionnels uniques. En tant qu'AE de terrain, vous faciliterez chaque étape du cycle de vente, de la découverte initiale à la négociation tarifaire, en passant par la présentation de notre solution.

Ce que vous ferez concrètement

  • Être un expert de la phase de découverte et un partenaire commercial stratégique pour les prospects, tout en gérant l'intégralité du cycle de vente.

  • Prospecter, qualifier et conclure de nouveaux contrats avec des grandes entreprises (+2500 collaborateurs), en vous appuyant sur votre vision stratégique pour démontrer la valeur de Qualified.

  • Travailler de manière active sur vos comptes cibles identifiés tout en développant et maintenant constamment un pipeline de ventes solide.

  • Orchestrer le cycle de vente pour vos prospects et savoir quand faire intervenir les bonnes parties prenantes.

  • Collaborer de manière transversale avec des partenaires clés tels que le Marketing, l'Ingénierie Avant-Vente, le Produit et le Customer Success.

  • Comprendre la concurrence pour vous positionner de manière stratégique sur notre marché.

Expérience requise

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous disposez de :

  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans la vente d’une plateforme technologique.
  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans un poste avec objectifs commerciaux (quota), idéalement sur le marché français.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la vente et du positionnement de solutions techniques SaaS et/ou PaaS auprès de clients.
  • 2 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le développement et l’expansion de comptes clients existants dans un environnement SaaS et/ou PaaS.
  • Une expérience démontrée dans la vente de contrats de 150 000 $ ou plus auprès d’organisations générant plus d’1 milliard de dollars de chiffre d’affaires.
  • Une maîtrise courante du français  et de l’anglais.

Ce serait un plus

  • Connaissance des technologies API-first et cloud native.
  • Une expérience préalable dans le domaine des CMS (systèmes de gestion de contenu).

More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at  

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects. The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition. The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.

Position Responsibilities

  • Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established – large, complex prospects and customer.
  • Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.
  • Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.
  • Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
  • Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close
  • Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer/prospect accounts.
  • Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI & TCO), technical and strategic value propositions
  • Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients
  • Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts
  • Negotiate and close deals following the company’s practices and processes
  • Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements
  • Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge
  • Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings
  • Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.

 

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree and proven sales experience.

description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

Most sales roles chase new logos. This one unlocks the revenue already inside Telnyx's customer base — and there's a lot of it.

As a Growth Account Executive (Expansion), you'll take commercial ownership of established Telnyx customers after their first 12 months, identifying and closing new revenue opportunities across our product portfolio, from Voice AI and programmable communications to messaging, connectivity, and AI infrastructure.

You'll own an assigned portfolio of existing customers, identify untapped opportunities, build relationships with new stakeholders, and drive expansion from prospecting through close.

This isn't traditional account management. You're not here to simply maintain relationships or renew contracts. You're here to grow accounts by introducing new products, expanding into new business units and geographies, and helping customers build more with Telnyx.

You're not farming. You're hunting inside the base.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow your accounts. Take commercial ownership of an assigned portfolio of established customers, developing strategies to drive incremental recurring revenue.
  • Find untapped opportunities. Analyze customer usage, product adoption, business models, and growth plans to identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling, and geographic expansion.
  • Hunt within existing accounts. Run targeted, personalized outbound campaigns to engage new stakeholders, departments, and decision-makers within your customer portfolio.
  • Own the expansion sales cycle. Lead discovery, qualify opportunities, develop commercial proposals, negotiate terms, and close expansion deals.
  • Sell across the Telnyx product portfolio. Identify opportunities spanning Voice AI, SIP trunking, programmable voice, messaging, WhatsApp Business, global numbers, wireless, and AI infrastructure.
  • Build strategic relationships. Develop connections with technical buyers, business leaders, and economic decision-makers to uncover new use cases and accelerate adoption.
  • Drive measurable revenue growth. Own an incremental MRR target, focusing on commercially attributable, profitable expansion rather than organic usage growth alone.
  • Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Hunter AEs during account transitions and partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to execute expansion strategies.
  • Own your forecast. Maintain accurate opportunities, account plans, and forecasts in Salesforce, ensuring clear visibility into pipeline health and commercial progress.
  • Bring customer intelligence back to Telnyx. Share market insights, product feedback, and emerging customer requirements to help shape our roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

What You Bring

  • Experience in B2B technology sales, ideally as an Account Executive, Growth AE, or in a commercially focused business development role.
  • A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting rather than relying exclusively on inbound demand.
  • A hunter mentality and the commercial curiosity to identify opportunities that aren't immediately obvious.
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders and building relationships with both technical and commercial decision-makers.
  • The ability to independently manage opportunities, develop business cases, and move deals through a structured sales process.
  • Strong account research and strategic thinking skills, including identifying whitespace and opportunities for cross-selling.
  • Comfort discussing technical products with developers, engineering teams, operations leaders, and executives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing pipeline and forecasts.
  • A proactive, accountable mindset with a genuine desire to own and deliver revenue results.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, telecom, cloud infrastructure, AI, or developer-focused technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Voice AI, SIP trunking, programmable communications, WhatsApp Business API, or messaging infrastructure.
  • Previous success in an expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or account-growth role.
  • Experience selling multiple products or solutions into the same organization.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or another structured qualification methodology.
  • Experience working with international or multinational customers across Europe.

Why This Role Matters

Telnyx customers are already building on our infrastructure, but many are only using a fraction of what our platform can offer.

A customer using us for SIP trunking might be a strong fit for Voice AI. A business operating in one country might be ready to expand across Europe. These opportunities don't always arrive as inbound requests. Someone needs to uncover them, build the business case, and turn them into revenue.

That's where you come in. You'll work on a warm base with real relationships, real usage data, and real expansion potential. The upside is there. You just have to go and find it.

You'll be measured on the incremental revenue you create, not simply the accounts you inherit.

Why Telnyx

  • Real technology, built in-house. We own our global network and build our communications and AI infrastructure, giving you a differentiated platform to sell.
  • A broad portfolio with real cross-sell potential. From global connectivity and programmable communications to Voice AI and AI infrastructure, there's always another customer challenge we can solve.
  • Profitable and independent. Join a company focused on sustainable growth and long-term investment in its technology.

En tant que HR People Associate chez Picnic, tu prendras en charge l’administration RH du quotidien pour nos équipes à Paris. Tes missions

  • Gérer l’administration de l’onboarding : collecter les documents nécessaires, coordonner les étapes administratives et t’assurer que tout est prêt pour le premier jour de chaque nouvelle recrue.
  • Assurer le suivi des documents RH : préparer les contrats, avenants, attestations et courriers à partir de nos modèles, coordonner leur validation et leur signature, puis veiller à leur bon classement.
  • Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet.

  • Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite.
  • Améliorer nos processus au quotidien : identifier les tâches qui pourraient être simplifiées, clarifier les checklists et améliorer nos outils de suivi pour gagner en fiabilité et en efficacité.
  • Élargir progressivement ton périmètre à l’international : une fois les processus français bien maîtrisés, prendre en charge deux ou trois activités administratives récurrentes pour nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne, avec un accompagnement adapté.

  • Tu es actuellement en formation idéalement en master RH, administration, gestion ou dans un domaine proche.

  • Tu peux travailler deux jours par semaine, pour un total de 14 ou 15 heures, pendant un an, avec un rythme compatible avec tes études.
  • Tu es organisé·e, tu as le souci du détail et tu suis les sujets jusqu’au bout. Tu sais demander de l’aide et signaler un blocage au bon moment.
  • Tu aimes aider les autres et tu traites les informations personnelles avec discrétion.
  • Tu es à l’aise avec les outils numériques, notamment Google Sheets ou Excel, et tu as envie d’apprendre à utiliser de nouveaux outils RH.
  • Une première expérience en RH ou en administration est un plus, mais nous recherchons surtout de la rigueur, de la curiosité et l’envie d’apprendre.

🍴 Restauration 

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.

Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.

Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.

description:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

Artefact is an AI-native company fusing engineering-grade delivery with strategic consulting to drive high-impact results. We specialize in accelerating end-to-end data and AI transformation, helping enterprises turn marketing into a predictable engine for business growth across the value chain. From strategy to implementation, Artefact delivers bespoke, scalable AI solutions tailored to our clients' core business challenges.

Headquartered in Paris, Artefact operates across 27 countries with a global team of over 2,500 employees, partnering with leading international brands across luxury, retail, FMCG, industry, healthcare, and finance.

To support our rapid expansion, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern) to join our Global Marketing team starting in January 2027 for a minimum of 6 months.

The Role

Are you passionate about B2B marketing, tech innovation, and generative AI? Do you want to work in an environment where your contributions directly accelerate business growth?

As the Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern), you will play a central role in driving Artefact’s flagship initiative: "AI-Augmented Marketing". This global project reshapes how our international marketing teams operate by embedding analytical rigor, agentic AI workflows, and operational excellence into everyday execution.

Working directly alongside the Group CMO, you will collaborate closely with regional marketing teams, data scientists, and business analysts worldwide. Fluency in English is essential, as you will lead international workshops, align stakeholders, and scale best practices across all Artefact entities.

What you will do

  1. Strategic orchestration: Support the Group CMO in executing the global AI-Augmented Marketing roadmap across three core pillars:
  • Analytics & strategy: Derive actionable insights from the marketing data platform to guide executive decision-making.
  • Agentic content workflows: Automate content operations by building and deploying an AI skill/agent library using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Lovable.
  • Global enablement: Scale adoption across international hubs by designing learning modules, documenting playbooks, and running hands-on training sessions in English.
  1. Go-to-market & revenue operations: Leverage AI tools and skills to optimize inbound and outbound funnels, drive pipeline velocity, and enhance Marketing-Sales alignment for sustained lead generation.
  2. Performance measurement & reporting: Build, maintain, and optimize full-funnel B2B performance dashboards (awareness, activation, ABM) to measure campaign ROI and surface continuous improvement opportunities.
  3. Operational excellence: Own and update cross-functional tracking tools, operational dashboards, and meeting cadences to maintain project momentum and organizational alignment.
  4. High-impact copywriting & editorial: Produce high-converting editorial assets (internal/external newsletters, landing pages, case studies, and thought leadership articles) while safeguarding brand tone and positioning.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s student from a top-tier Business School (Grande École de Commerce) or equivalent university program.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong data-driven problem-solving abilities; comfortable working with analytics platforms, data modeling, and reporting frameworks.
  • AI & Tech native: A genuine passion for emerging technologies, generative & agentic AI tools, and B2B growth marketing.
  • Communication & copywriting: Bilingual or fluent in English (both written and spoken) with exceptional writing skills across long-form, web, and newsletter formats.
  • Project management: High organizational agility, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset: Proactive, autonomous, results-oriented, and excited to collaborate with cross-functional, international teams.

Additional Details

  • Start date: January 2027
  • Duration: 6 months minimum
  • Location: Paris Headquarters (with hybrid flexibility)
  • Salary : 1200€
  • Opportunity: High potential for conversion into a permanent contract (CDI) based on mutual fit and performance.

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit solely based on merit and business needs, fostering an inclusive environment free from discrimination of any kind.

Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless. Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability. Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed. Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases. Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a People Tech & Analytics Engineer on the People team, you will build the systems, data pipelines, and automations behind how Mistral runs People Operations. Reporting to the People Tech & Analytics Lead, you will turn the roadmap into reality: wiring our HR tech stack together, making data flow reliably between systems, and automating people processes with third-party tools as well as Mistral's own models, agents, and APIs. This is an individual contributor role for someone who loves building. You will spend most of your time in the systems and the data, deep-diving into problems: connecting HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity, and finance tools, standing up the data layer behind our people metrics, and shipping automations that remove manual work from the People team. If you are a data engineer or people technology specialist who wants to deliver meaningful automation outcomes at Europe's largest AI company, this is the role for you. What You Will Do Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations and data pipelines across our HR systems (HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance), run data quality checks, and fix inconsistencies at the source. Implement and evolve the Metabase visualisation layer of our people data lake, build the dashboards and self-serve reporting managers and People partners rely on, and run hands-on analyses of workforce trends, retention and organisational health, supporting the move to conversational insights for leadership. Design, build, test and document automated workflows, mainly with Mistral's own models, agents and APIs, with human review wherever decisions affect people, monitor live automations with alerting, error handling, logging and runbooks, and prototype AI use cases on people processes, productionising the ones that prove their worth. Implement configuration changes across the HR tech stack (workflows, fields, roles and permissions, new countries and entities), support testing and rollout of system changes and integrations, and act as first-line troubleshooter for the People team, leading issue resolution through to production with a clear audit trail. Architect end-to-end HR workflows with key stakeholders in HR Operations, Business Partnering and Reward, and implement data governance in practice: quality standards, access controls, retention rules and audit trails for employee data. Real automation experience: you have built and maintained workflows in n8n or similar tools such as Make, Zapier, Workato or Langdock, and you are excited to do the same with Mistral's own models and tooling. Working experience with data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery) and the modern data stack (dbt or similar), and with visualisation tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau or Power BI. description:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

  • Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. No separate ivory-tower architect required.
    Reviewing and choosing well. You read far more code than you write, and your value is in the quality of review: catching the silent assumption, the security flaw, the architectural drift, knowing where models fail and looking there first. You pick the right tool for the job (Claude Code for a deep refactor, an inline assistant when that is enough, a sub-agent for parallel work, the right model for analysis versus generation) and you know the constraints differ by client, an enterprise like PayPoint or Natwest versus a scale-up type business like Zuto or OAG.
    Working with non-determinism. You see where AI moves the bottleneck and help people left and right of you unblock the value stream. You build with AI components but know success is no longer a binary, reaching for evals, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths as naturally as you reach for unit tests.

Technical breadth across the full stack

Exceptional means depth in at least one area but competence everywhere the system reaches.

  • Backend: an instinct for distributed systems (what fails, what is eventually consistent, where queues back up), APIs that age well, thoughtful data modelling, and an understanding that languages are mostly syntax differences you can close with AI.
    Cloud: cost-aware and security-aware by default, reaching for IaC, composing the primitives rather than stitching together managed services and hoping it works.
    Data: modern pipelines, governance and lineage, increasingly vector stores and embeddings, with data quality treated as seriously as production code because garbage in, garbage out is far worse once AI features depend on it.
    Web and mobile: past the framework arguments, with a clear view on what you would pick today, and able to build "good enough" front ends yourself with AI.

Full-stack here means seeing the platform as one system and knowing which levers matter most. It does not mean front-end work with a few Node.js servers.

System thinking, consulting and commercial judgement

At CreateFuture we work in a consultancy context, where many otherwise excellent IC engineers can struggle.

You know technology is roughly 30% of the picture; the rest is design, argument and reasoning, commercial and political acumen, and the clarity to frame outcomes for a COO, CTO, CIO or CEO in their own language.

You know when gold-plating is wasteful, you can name when a project's real problem is not technical and say so even when it is awkward, and you have a strong sense of what is durable versus what is fashion.

You are not the engineer who introduced the team to seven new technologies last year; you are the one who removed three and quietly made the remaining stack stronger.

Leadership mentality

Technical work is necessary but no longer sufficient. By default you raise the level of everyone around you, regardless of discipline.

  • Communicate clearly and frequently (documents, decisions, post-mortems, design notes); the written artefact is the machine-readable context we can feed to AI later.
  • Make decisions and own them. You don't escalate everything or hoard control, and you are willing to be the benevolent dictator when it is your turn.
  • Mentor in AI fluency, not just code: tooling, prompting and review discipline, so your team is twice as productive a year from now.
  • Need little line management. You communicate upwards, raise by exception, self-resolve, and can be trusted with financial controls.
  • Disagree well. You tell people they are wrong with evidence and no ego, and you change your own mind when you are shown to be wrong.

What we're not looking for

  • The gifted engineer who sits in a silo. This is a team game.
  • The one who is fluent with AI but ships without the guardrails and quality gates enterprise clients expect.
  • The one with strong technical opinions who cannot justify them commercially and gets defensive when challenged.
  • The pure manager who wants to orchestrate teams rather than get involved. This is about setting a new standard, not coordinating it.
  • The engineer who will not immerse in a client environment. This role will mean on-site work and trusted relationships built in person. We are not going back to working away from the client and being bypassed.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. What's the opportunity?

Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process. Not sure which Support role is right for you? We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. What you’ll own Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved. Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. You should not apply if: You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership. Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting. You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself. You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes. You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions. You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works. About Ashby Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com. About Go To Market We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby. Interview process Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days. Benefits Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO.
