description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there
  • Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice
  • Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion
  • Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP
  • Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation
  • Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements
  • Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages
  • Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn
  • Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government
  • The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset
  • Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place
  • A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal
  • A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams
  • Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes
  • Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers
  • Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues
  • Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it
  • The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials
  • Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both
  • Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it 
  • A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions

 

À propos du poste

En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.

Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. La première année, la réussite se mesurera moins à un grand chiffre qu'à votre capacité à installer Anthropic auprès de l'État français : une stratégie claire, les bonnes fondations et nos premiers accords stratégiques.

Responsabilités

  • Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains d'action, nos leviers de succès et ce qu'il nous faut construire pour y parvenir
  • Incarner Anthropic au plus haut niveau auprès de l'État français, en nouant des relations de confiance avec les cabinets ministériels, les cadres dirigeants de l'administration et les responsables du numérique et de la technologie des plus grands ministères, dont la défense, les finances et la justice
  • Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension
  • Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de partenariat, accords-cadres et centrales d'achat telles que l'UGAP
  • Collaborer au quotidien avec notre responsable des affaires publiques en France, pour que les démarches commerciales et politiques se renforcent mutuellement, en cohérence avec la stratégie et la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'IA
  • Mener les échanges clients sur la souveraineté des données, la sécurité et la conformité (par exemple SecNumCloud et la doctrine « cloud au centre »), et travailler avec les équipes Sécurité, Juridique et Produit sur la façon dont nous répondons à ces exigences
  • Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps
  • Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements
  • Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France

Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez

  • Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française
  • L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ
  • Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore
  • Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation
  • Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques
  • Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente
  • Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients
  • L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles
  • Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction
  • La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau
  • Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues
  • La disponibilité pour engager une procédure d'habilitation de sécurité si certains comptes l'exigent
  • Un engagement sincère en faveur d'une IA sûre et bénéfique, et la capacité d'expliquer pourquoi cela compte pour les institutions publiques

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description: BlockTech is hiring a Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll take ownership of our trading systems and bring new direction to the desk. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short. What will you do? You'll own the systems that trade our capital, from day-to-day operation to the strategies that come next. As a senior trader, you'll also use what you've learned elsewhere to shape where the desk goes. You will: Own the systems. Monitor, operate, and tune our automated trading systems in live markets. Manage the risk. Manage positions and risk, adjusting pricing and parameters as market behaviour shifts. Set new directions. Bring new ideas to the desk, drawing on your previous experience. Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers. Spot what’s next. Identify and research new business opportunities as markets change. What we're looking for You'll need: A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science. 3+ years of quantitative trading experience. Proficiency in Python, with excellent numerical and algorithmic skills. Focus and sound judgment behind the screen when markets get busy. Bonus points for: Experience at a proprietary trading firm or hedge fund, particularly with mid-frequency strategies, prediction markets or DeFi. You don't need: crypto experience. If you've successfully traded derivatives on other asset classes and want to bring that experience to BlockTech, we want to hear from you. Pay, location, and relocation Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results. Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund. Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa. Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling. What else is in it for you Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day How we work We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from. This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development. Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

About Voyagu Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems. The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted. Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in. This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first. What you are expected to do Technical ownership Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner. Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more. Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources. Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts. Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price. Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice. Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work. Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures. Vision and delivery Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it. Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task. Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking. Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you. AI-driven development Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand. Explain and defend how to use AI effectively. Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better. Team Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded. Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people. What you need to succeed You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough. You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each. You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice. You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead. You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders. You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively. You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations. You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe. You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough. Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on. Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature. Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important. Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge. What you get You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully. You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between. You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off. You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs. A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake. A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours. Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models. Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate. How to apply Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well. Desired Experience Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source Exa is an equal opportunity employer.   • Familiarity with simulation tools such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins

The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year over year growth. 

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer’s adoption on an ongoing basis. 
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: You’ll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success.

You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers’ organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you’re able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.

  • Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities. You operate with a high level of urgency at all times. You thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment. 
  • Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You view feedback as a necessity for growth so consistently seek it out and give it.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You have a hunger for knowledge and are naturally a question-asker. 
  • Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data Platform Engineer to build and scale enterprise data services centered on SingleStore Helios and PostgreSQL. You will work with teams across regions to deliver reliable, well-governed data services.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop and optimize SingleStore and PostgreSQL schemas, SQL queries, physical data models, indexing and workload performance.
  • Build and maintain reliable batch, streaming and CDC ingestion pipelines from relational databases, object storage and other enterprise sources into SingleStore; implement validation, transformation, enrichment and data curation.
  • Lead technical assessments and migrations of existing applications and data workloads to SingleStore, while onboarding new teams, applications and services.
  • Build reusable self-service onboarding capabilities, including APIs, configuration templates, automated provisioning, access requests, pipeline deployment and operational guardrails.
  • Optimize cloud database spend through workload right-sizing, consolidation, scheduling and performance tuning; develop transparent SingleStore cluster, application and team-level cost allocation and showback.
  • Own production readiness and database reliability: monitoring, incident triage, root-cause analysis, recoverability, deployment controls and collaboration with SingleStore Helios support.
  • Integrate data quality, lineage, ownership and access controls into delivery workflows; work with the enterprise data catalog and governance teams.
  • Create engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, documentation and cross-region handoffs that reduce manual operational work.

What you'll bring

What you need

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in data platform engineering, database engineering or closely related production data roles.
  • Advanced SQL and PostgreSQL expertise, including query plans, schema design, performance tuning and operational troubleshooting.
  • Strong Python and practical experience developing production-grade ingestion and transformation pipelines, with testing and observability.
  • Experience with distributed or cloud-managed databases and modern data integration patterns, including batch and CDC; familiarity with cloud object storage as an ingestion and staging layer.
  • Ability to own end-to-end technical delivery, collaborate with application teams and solve complex production issues independently.

We'd love if you had

  • Hands-on SingleStore (MemSQL) or SingleStore Helios experience, including pipelines, performance tuning and workload design.
  • Kafka or similar streaming platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and API-driven platform automation.
  • Experience building self-service data platforms, data quality frameworks, metadata/catalog integrations and chargeback/showback reporting.
  • Experience with cloud FinOps, database migrations or financial-services enterprise data.

Who We Are

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.

Our Culture

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact.   • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments.

  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM.
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments.
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming).
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning).
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking.
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads).
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication.
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking.
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems.
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers Example projects Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely. Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency. Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well. Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result. Logistics Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich. description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen. Wij vragen HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience Python.
  • Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Proven experience working with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.
  • Deep understanding of observability practices, with practical experience using OpenTelemetry (OTel) and related tooling.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills

Je beschrijft en ontwikkelt de technische architectuur inclusief bijkomende integraties. Join the journey

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zet technische best practices op voor klanten en (interne) collega's. Als Technical Architect ben je de motivator voor de technische collega's van het klantteam. Als digital leader naar de klant ben je in staat om breder te kijken dan de oplossing die wij leveren en zie je deze in het totale end-to-end klantproces.

Als Technical Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technische deel van de oplossing. Daarnaast:

  • Ben je betrokken in de designfase en bepaal je welke technologieën kunnen worden gebruikt in welke scenario's;
  • Draag je bij aan de technische best practices van HSO en draag je deze ook uit naar de klant en het team;
  • Fungeer je fungeer als technische vraagbaak voor de technische en functionele consultants;
  • Houd je je bezig met integraties met andere (third-party) applicaties, denk je mee over integration patterns;
  • Zorg je ervoor dat alles in source control terecht komt en dat er automatisch uitgerold wordt d,m,v, Azure DevOps pipelines;
  • Samen met de Product Owner stel je een roadmap op voor technische verbeteringen.


Wat vertellen onze huidige technische architecten over deze rol?

“Het werk als technische architect is heel erg uitdagend en gevarieerd. Je werkt samen met hele leuke collega’s op projecten. Op het project ben je verantwoordelijk voor de algehele kwaliteit en samenhang van het IT-landschap. Primair binnen de kaders van het project. Echter doordat je implementatie altijd samenhangt met andere systemen ben je ook veel bezig met het landschap buiten het Microsoft project. Je bepaalt samen met de klant waar je naartoe gaat over de jaren heen en ziet jouw plannen dan werkelijkheid worden.

Als je het leuk vindt is er ook altijd ruimte om op de inhoud in te gaan. Als je dat doet ben je vooral bezig met de complexe onderdelen van het project en dat is erg leuk en uitdagend. Naast de projecten houd je je bezig met de best practices van HSO. Je krijgt daardoor altijd de nieuwe ontwikkelingen mee en krijgt de kans om daar wat mee te doen.”

 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met Power Platform (Dynamics 365 CE, CRM) implementaties in een technische rol;
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring in programmeertaal C#;
  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden die je inzet bij het aansturen van de techneuten;
  • Je bent in staat om op basis van de behoeften van de klant een technisch ontwerp te maken en de structuur van de oplossing uit te denken;
  • Je bent in staat om de best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd hierbij leidend te laten zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten;
  • Je bent in staat de implementatie te begeleiden volgens de overeengekomen architectuur en infrastructuur;
  • Je bent inhoudelijk, analytisch, ondernemend, kwaliteitsbewust en creatief.

 

Wat bieden we jou?  
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  


Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO  
HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

Mission Brief

As a Working Student in the Loads & Dynamics team, you will be at the heart of launch vehicle development. Every structural component, subsystem, and design decision ultimately depends on one fundamental question: what environments and loads will the vehicle experience during flight? 

Our team provides the engineering foundation that answers this question. By combining expertise in structural loads, dynamics, aerodynamics, thermal analysis, and fluid dynamics, we predict and characterize the complex physical environments encountered throughout all phases of flight. 

You will work directly with experienced engineers on real development activities, flight data analysis, and engineering methods used to support current and future launch vehicle programs. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with aerospace engineering challenges while contributing to safe, reliable, and independent access to space. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Flight & Test Data Analysis 
    • Support the verification and validation of loads and dynamics methodologies 
    • Develop tools and scripts for efficient data processing and comparison 
    • Compare analytical and numerical predictions against test and flight results 
    • Identify opportunities to improve models, processes, and engineering methods 
  • Post-Processing & Visualization 
    • Develop and improve automated workflows for simulation and test data evaluation 
    • Generate flow visualizations, section views, and engineering-relevant data extracts 
  • Sensors & Instrumentation 
    • Support sensor-related activities, including documentation and configuration management 
    • Perform trade studies and evaluate instrumentation solutions for flight and test campaigns 
  • Multidisciplinary Engineering Support 
    • Contribute to a broad range of Loads & Dynamics activities across the vehicle development lifecycle 
    • Gain exposure to structural loads, structural dynamics, aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, and thermal analysis

  • Currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g. Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Physics or similar)  
  • Interest in data analysis, simulation, and physical systems 
  • Programming experience with Python or Matlab 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with professional proficiency in English. 
  • Located in or near Munich, as the role requires regular on-site presence 

Bonus Skills

  • Basic knowledge of structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, or aerospace engineering 
  • Experience with CFD postprocessing tools such as ParaView, Tecplot, StarCCM+, Ansys

description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet's success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world's largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. Our team spans North America and Berlin. Given the scale of our fleet, automation is at the heart of our operations. You'll develop and maintain critical software, transforming large datasets into actionable metrics.

As a Working Student, you'll support daily satellite operations, analyze data, triage and resolve anomalies, run on-orbit experiments, test and deploy software both on the ground and in orbit, and commission satellites. You'll work closely with hardware and software experts across teams to debug anomalies, enhance or create services, and provide operational insights to shape our next-generation satellites. 

We are looking for a data-driven self-starter with effective communication skills that collaborates well within a technical team and adapts quickly to changing tasks and contexts.

This part-time, hybrid role is based at our Berlin office which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Develop and maintain real-time, mission-critical software solutions for satellite operations
  • Write scripts to aggregate satellite data and generate system monitoring metrics
  • Analyze data to identify issues and inefficiencies in the full stack of services and propose solutions to improve productivity
  • Drive improvements to fleet capacity and productivity through process enhancements
  • Monitor satellite health and perform on-orbit experiments

What You Bring:

  • Ongoing BSc in engineering or computer science
  • Proficiency in software development, particularly in Python or equivalent languages
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in statistical analysis
  • Proactive, self-starter approach to engineering and problem-solving
  • Effective interpersonal and collaboration skills within a technical team

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with agile software development
  • Experience with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, GitLab, Docker, Jenkins, Bash, Linux, CI/CD, Sentry, Datadog)
  • Familiarity with satellite engineering and/or the space environment and its challenges
  • Hands-on experience operating spacecraft or remote systems
  • Familiarity with automation and optimization tools
  • Contributions to open-source software projects

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off 
  • Employee Wellness Program 
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

Compensation:

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

 
Germany Salary Range
$18—$18 USD

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

Demonstrated experience managing senior client stakeholders — VP level or above — independently. Track record on large-scale, commercially significant digital transformation programmes. Architect multi-agent orchestration topologies — supervisor/worker hierarchies, event-driven graphs, parallel execution — with defined A2A handoff contracts, shared state schemas, and structured escalation paths. Configure the LLM gateway and model routing layer — directing agent calls by task type, latency, cost, and capability — using provider-agnostic abstraction (LiteLLM or equivalent) across LLM providers. Tool Layer, Context, and Memory Design, build, and maintain MCP servers exposing enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms as agent-accessible tools — with robust schema design, error handling, idempotency, and retry logic. Translate business processes into agent-executable skills, structured instructions, and reusable workflows — bridging the gap between business requirements and agent implementation. Build context engineering pipelines — assembling the right information into the agent context window across multi-turn and long-running tasks, with explicit management of context budget and retrieval triggers. Implement memory architectures — episodic, working, and long-term — using appropriate backends (vector stores, relational databases, cache layers) matched to each agent use case. Knowledge Layer and Engineering Design RAG pipelines for agentic contexts: hybrid search, semantic re-ranking, late chunking, multi-vector retrieval, and metadata filtering; manage the full lifecycle from ingestion through quality evaluation. Build MCP-connected knowledge sources exposing structured and unstructured data assets as governed, agent-accessible tools. Implement Text-to-SQL capabilities — prompt-to-query translation, schema grounding, query validation, and safe execution against live enterprise databases. Integrate Elasticsearch as a retrieval backend: full-text search, BM25 scoring, faceted filtering, and hybrid semantic-lexical strategies. Design knowledge graph and ontology layers providing agents with structured representations of domain entities and relationships for precise reasoning over interconnected enterprise knowledge. Agent Ops, Registry, and Observability Operate and maintain production agentic systems using AgentOps, LLMOps, and DevOps practices — CI/CD pipelines for agent code and prompt changes, automated evaluation gates, and deployment strategies (blue/green, canary) across environments. Manage an agent and asset registry — versioned catalogue of agents, tools, skills, prompts, and workflows — enabling reuse, governance, and controlled promotion across development, staging, and production. Define and implement agent evaluation frameworks: golden dataset construction, LLM-as-judge pipelines, tool-call accuracy measurement, trajectory evaluation, and faithfulness scoring. Build agent testing suites distinct from evals — unit testing agents with mocked tools, integration testing multi-agent handoffs, and simulation environments for pre-production scenario testing. Design HITL feedback capture: structuring human corrections and approvals as refinement signal for continuous improvement. Build production observability from day one — distributed tracing, token-level cost tracking, latency profiling, failure logging, and drift detection. Trust, Safety, and Responsible AI Implement guardrail frameworks (NeMo Guardrails, LlamaGuard, or equivalent) for input and output validation, content filtering, and enforcement of agent behavioural boundaries. Defend against prompt injection in agents that consume external content — documents, emails, web pages — and scope agent identity and credentials to the minimum required for each task. Implement PII detection and redaction in agent inputs and outputs; design immutable audit trails of agent decisions and tool calls for compliance and forensic purposes. Define blast radius controls and human-in-the-loop approval gates; ensure autonomous systems operate within governance boundaries agreed with the client. Conduct code reviews and enforce engineering standards across the full stack — Python backend, frontend, cloud-native infrastructure, and DevOps/AgentOps/LLMOps pipelines. Proven experience deploying complex software systems in production environments — with demonstrable results; deep understanding of what it takes to make systems reliable at scale. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP Gen AI Hub Good to have skills : NA Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: We are Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to to design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade SAP GenAI solutions & experience with with the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & other AI cloud platforms The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in AI Core, Generative AI Hub, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Knowledge Graphs with hands-on experience orchestrating intelligent pipelines using LangChain / LangGraph frameworks, Vector Engines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. You will work with multi-disciplinary teams to embed Generative AI into SAP-centric business applications and processes, ensuring scalability, compliance, and measurable business impact. Prerequisite for RDE: Translate business processes into AI-driven workflows, integrating Agentic AI patterns and SAP s AI services to deliver scalable, intelligent, and automation-ready applications. Own end-to-end implementation, from data and model integration through solution architecture, development, testing, and deployment within SAP landscapes and customer environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, data, and customer teams to drive AI adoption, optimize models in production, and continuously enhance solution quality and impact. Experience with Transforming SAP Business processes with AI & infusing Agentic AI innovations in SAP space. Strategic thinking, client-focused articulation & effective demo/communication experience. Industry & Function Roles: SAP Process AI & Innovations Expert in Supply Chain or FI or Industry Space, Nice to have - Experience with BPM & tools like Signavio Good understanding of SAP standard AI features & setup For functional & industrial roles, a fair understanding of AI technologies and how it influences business processes SAP Certifications preferred - SAP Certified Associate - Positioning SAP Business AI Solutions as part of SAP Business Suite Roles & Responsibilities: - Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery using Generative and Agentic AI to solve complex business problems, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise operations for measurable impact. - Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SAP BTP and GenAI solutions. - Building technical architecture design aligning with SAP and enterprise standards. - Architect and implement Generative AI pipelines on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine + Knowledge Graph Engine). - Design and manage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG workflows to improve the grounding, accuracy, and interpretability of LLM outputs. - Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs) with enterprise data sources through grounding modules, vector similarity search, and semantic search. - Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications. - Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing. - Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats. - Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. - Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. - Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. - Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. - Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projects—from model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. - Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. - Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. - Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle. - Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Professional & Technical Skills: - Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine). - Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. - Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search. - Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases. - Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization. - Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices & AI evaluation frameworks. - Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. - Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. - Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. - Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. - Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. - Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. - Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. - Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. - Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. - Ability to analyze and optimize application performance. Technical Experience - End-to-end Python application development, with hands-on experience on agentic AI frameworks. - Experience in building SAP BTP GenAI application leveraging SAP AI Core & Gen AI Hub. - Experience in building APIs and ETL pipelines using Python. - Exposure to LLM (Large Language Model) integration and LangChain or similar frameworks. - Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent. - Proven capability in identifying and implementing BTP Business AI Services. Additional Information: - Completed minimum of 15 years of full-time education with Bachelor s or Master s (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA) in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics & Communication from a recognized institution. - Ability to translate GenAI architectures into business outcomes — articulate ROI, adoption, and scalability value. - Strong leadership and team management skills. - Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation abilities. - Demonstrated experience in managing AI-centric innovation programs. - Self-driven, adaptable, and passionate about emerging AI technologies. - Experience in SAP BTP / Azure development or architecture, with at least 4-5 years focused on AI / ML / GenAI. - Experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) - Demonstrated knowledge of GraphRAG and Vector Engine–based retrieval for large-scale enterprise use cases. - Certifications in Python Development, SAP BTP Solution Architect, SAP GenAI Developer or AI-related frameworks are a plus. - Strong communication and leadership skills for client engagement and stakeholder management. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, military veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
